invariant: json.encode(value) is available in every tier with no capability grant and goes through the same serializable-only walk a script's own return value goes through: depth/node caps, no functions/userdata/threads, no cycles, non-finite numbers rejected -- never a second, independently-tuned cap.

cases: scalars and a nested table/array under a read-only trigger with no capabilities configured
a value nested past the shared depth cap
a table wide past the shared node-count cap
a function, userdata, or thread value
a table with an attached __index-style metatable, if one can be constructed in this guest at all

mustHold: json.encode is reachable and callable under a read-only trigger with zero grants
a well-formed value encodes to valid JSON text equivalent to the guest value
an oversized or too-deep value fails cleanly with the same reason taxonomy a return-value marshal rejection uses, never a hang
a cycle is detected and rejected without stack overflow or hang
a non-finite number is rejected, never silently coerced to null or to a string
any metatable on the value being encoded is not consulted, or is documented as inert for this guest
